report.title: Report a concern
report.intro: Tell us in your own words what worries you. There are no wrong answers, and you don't need to know any security terms.
report.useForm: Prefer a form? Use the form instead
report.useChat: Talk it through with the assistant instead

chat.firstPrompt: What are you worried might happen?
chat.aiNotice: You're talking to an AI assistant, not a person. It only helps you put your concern into words. A person reviews everything before anything is decided.
chat.composerHint: Press Enter to send. Shift and Enter starts a new line.
chat.summaryReady: The assistant has summarised your concern. Check it below.

summary.title: Here's what I understood
summary.intro: Check each answer and change anything that isn't right. Nothing is reported until you send it.
summary.safeguardsHint: Leave empty if nothing does yet.
summary.toConfirmHint: Questions a reviewer should check with you or others.
summary.estimateNote: Only a guess to help the reviewer. A person decides the real figures.
summary.noEstimate: The assistant didn't have enough to make a rough estimate.

form.fallback: The assistant couldn't continue. Your answers are kept — finish with the form below.
form.worryLegend: What are you worried might happen?
form.titleHint: A few words, so you can find it again.
form.affectedHint: For example a customer list, a laptop or the payroll app. You can leave it empty.
form.assetTypeLabel: What kind of thing is it?
form.causeLegend: What could cause it, and what would happen then?
form.safeguardsLegend: Is anything already protecting against this?
form.safeguardsHint: Leave empty if nothing does yet.

site.none: Not sure, or not one site

done.title: Thank you. Your concern is reported.
done.body: Someone will look at it soon. You can follow it under your concerns.

errors.tooLong: This answer is too long. Please shorten it.
errors.assetRequired: Name the affected thing, or remove it.
errors.toConfirmRequired: Write the question, or remove it.
errors.notAccepted: This couldn't be sent. Check your answers and try again.
errors.closed: This conversation has already ended. Start a new report to continue.
errors.forbidden: You can't report concerns here. Ask your administrator if you think you should.
errors.unavailable: We couldn't reach the workspace. Please try again in a moment.
errors.summary: Some answers need another look. They're marked below.

concerns.title: Concerns you reported
concerns.intro: Everything you reported, newest first, and where each one stands.
concerns.empty: You haven't reported any concerns yet.
